program:
app "Tape ball" ball mint
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool, out bool
let legal = count(ball where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs all) + count(ball where wide = yes)
runs "/" count(ball where out = yes) big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) "." legal % 6 "of 6" faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 1
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes
button "Undo" tap remove last(ball)
if legal >= 36
  "Innings over" head color warn
button "New match" tap remove all ball
describe:
Tape ball, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- ball: runs: number, 0 to 6, starts at 0; wide: yes or no; out: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- legal is how many ball entries where wide is no.
- runs is the total runs of ball plus how many ball entries where wide is yes.
Shows:
- text: runs, "/", how many ball entries where out is yes.
- text: "Overs", legal divided by 6 rounded down, ".", legal leaves over when divided by 6, "of 6".
- for 0, 1, 2, 4, 6:
  - a button the value; a tap adds a ball with runs set to the value.
- a button "Wide"; a tap adds a ball with wide set to yes.
- a button "Out"; a tap adds a ball with out set to yes.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest ball entries, with undo.
- if legal is at least 36:
  - text: "Innings over".
- a button "New match"; a tap removes all ball entries, with one undo.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with the numbers or units

app "Car service" car slate
table service done_on date = today, odometer num 0.., cost money, garage text
setting every_km num = 5000 "Service every (km)"

let due_km = last(service.odometer) + every_km

list service by day

- due date is the latest done on of service moved by every months months.

- text: "Service is due very soon. Km left:" when odo is at least due km minus 500, otherwise "Km to next service:", due km minus odo.

program:
app "Medicine cabinet" pill plum
table med_item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 10, price money?, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(med_item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "medicines running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each med_item where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(med_item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form med_item
remind "Check your medicines" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Medicine cabinet, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- med item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 10; price: money, optional; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the med item have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "medicines running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each med item where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the med item for editing; a swipe removes the med item, with undo:
    - text: the name of the med item.
    - text: the kind of the med item.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the med item.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the med item to the qty of the med item minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the med item.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the med item to the qty of the med item plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the med item.
- a form to add a med item.
Reminder "Check your medicines" at 9:00 on Sat.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with who it is for

app "Evening routine" moon ink
table wind name text

screen main "Today" check

  each wind
    row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
      stack grow
        it.name bold
        streak(it.wind_done) "day streak" faint

screen stats "Stats" chart
  heat last 70 days, count(wind_done on it), n

program:
app "Exams" calendar ocean
table exam subject text, day date, hours num 1..100 = 10
table studied exam ref exam, mins num 5..600
each exam where day >= today sort day as e
  stack card gap 1 tap edit e
    row
      e.subject bold grow
      e.day - today "days" bold color if(e.day - today <= 3, warn, ink)
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(e.studied.mins) / (e.hours * 60), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
    sum(e.studied.mins) "of" e.hours * 60 "min studied" faint
    button "+30 min" tap add studied exam = e, mins = 30
remind "Exam tomorrow, rest well" at exam.day - 1d at 20:00
form exam, "Add exam"
describe:
Exams, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- exam: subject: text; day: date; hours: number, 1 to 100, starts at 10. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- studied: exam: a exam; mins: number, 5 to 600. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each exam where day is at least today sorted by day:
  - a group; a tap opens the exam for editing:
    - text: the subject of the exam.
    - text: the day of the exam minus today, "days".
    - a drawing made of rectangles.
    - text: the total mins of the exam's studied entries, "of", the hours of the exam times 60, "min studied".
    - a button "+30 min"; a tap adds a studied with exam set to the exam, mins set to 30.
- a form to add a exam.
Reminder "Exam tomorrow, rest well" on each day of the exam entries, 24 hours before at 20:00.
